1.web: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
1.asv: Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, Andmy fingers to fight:

2.web: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge; who subdues my people under me.
2.asv: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.

3.web: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
3.asv: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

4.web: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
4.asv: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

5.web: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
5.asv: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

6.web: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
6.asv: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.

7.web: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners;
7.asv: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;

8.web: whose mouths speak deceit, Whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
8.asv: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

9.web: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
9.asv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

10.web: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
10.asv: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

11.web: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
11.asv: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

12.web: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
12.asv: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;

13.web: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
13.asv: Whenour garners are full, affording all manner of store, Andour sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;

14.web: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
14.asv: Whenour oxen are well laden; When there isno breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:

15.web: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
15.asv: Happy is the people that is in such a case; Yea, happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.
